objective: Fix asi_jpn (-0.25, limit 1.0) for gJ9no95Q (sh1.61). Creative ideas: cap-decile bucket sizes, group_neutralize, ts_rank w=15/25, country-only grouping.

alphas.verdict: Coarser cap bucket (0.2) drops sh below 1.58 (1.57). asi_jpn WORSE (-0.28 vs -0.25).
Even coarser cap bucket (0.25) drops sh further (1.56). asi_jpn -0.26, no improvement.
Finer cap bucket (0.05) hurts everything: sh1.54, 2Y1.51 (ladder fail). asi_jpn -0.27. Finer grouping = smaller groups = worse.
group_neutralize drops sh to 1.56. asi_jpn unchanged (-0.25). Residual-based doesn't fix Japan.
w=15 keeps sh1.60 but asi_jpn WORST (-0.33) AND PPA fails (robust universe). Too noisy. w=20 is the sweet spot.
BEST asi_jpn (-0.18) but sh drops below threshold (1.55<1.58). Trade-off confirmed: longer window = better Japan but lower overall sh.
Removing cap bucket makes asi_jpn WORSE (-0.32). Cap bucketing actually HELPS Japan, not hurts it. subU drops to 0.57.
group_neutralize + country-only: asi_jpn -0.32 (same as expr7). Confirms country-only is worse for Japan.

key_findings.CONCLUSION: asi_jpn is STRUCTURAL and CANNOT be fixed with these techniques. ALL 8 variants fail asi_jpn (-0.18 to -0.33). The signal is reversed in Japan - this is a property of star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1 in ASI/MINVOL1M, not a parameter tuning issue.
key_findings.cap_bucket_analysis: Coarser buckets (0.2: -0.28, 0.25: -0.26) and finer (0.05: -0.27) all WORSE than base 0.1 (-0.25). Original 0.1 is optimal for asi_jpn. Removing cap bucket entirely (country-only) makes it WORSE (-0.32). Cap bucketing HELPS Japan.
key_findings.group_neutralize: Doesn't help asi_jpn (-0.25 with cap, -0.32 without). Residual-based approach doesn't fix Japan reversal. Also drops sh below 1.58.
key_findings.ts_rank_window_tradeoff: CONFIRMED: w=15 (asi_jpn -0.33, sh1.60), w=20 (asi_jpn -0.25, sh1.61), w=25 (asi_jpn -0.18, sh1.55), w=30 (asi_jpn -0.16, sh1.49). Longer window = better Japan but lower sh. w=25 gets asi_jpn to -0.18 but drops sh below 1.58 threshold. Cannot have both sh>1.58 AND asi_jpn>0.
key_findings.best_asi_jpn: expr6 (w=25) achieves asi_jpn -0.18 but sh 1.55 < 1.58. Gap to positive asi_jpn is still 1.18. STRUCTURAL.
key_findings.decision: Accept gJ9no95Q (b16 expr3, sh1.61/asi_jpn -0.25) as alpha #1. It passes 7/8 thresholds. asi_jpn is structural Japan weakness (forum-documented: 'forcing japan to compare within small env loses meaning if all japan declines'). No variant can fix asi_jpn while maintaining sh>1.58.

best_alpha: gJ9no95Q (b16 expr3) remains best: sh1.61/fit0.76/2Y2.20/rn_sh1.64/margin6.33bp/tvr8.75%/ops7. b17 could not improve asi_jpn without sacrificing sh.
